surgery.note: 全身麻酔導入時の遷延性低血圧予防のため休薬。添付文書は「手術前 24 時間は投与しないことが望ましい」 (米国 ACC/AHA 2024 も 24 時間。表示は 1 日に切り上げ)。プレミネント配合錠 (+ HCTZ) も本基準

surgery.dose_dependent_summary: 高血圧治療のため + 血圧コントロール良好 +… 1日 (24時間), HFrEF 継続可
surgery.source_title: 2024 AHA/ACC/ACS/ASNC/HRS/SCA/SCCT/SCMR/SVM Guideline for Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery
surgery.quote_excerpt:
Rec 1 (COR 2b, LOE B-R): "In select* patients on chronic renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system
inhibitors (RAASi) for HTN undergoing elevated-risk NCS, omission 24 hours before surgery may
be beneficial to limit intraoperative hypotension."
Rec 2 (COR 2a, LOE C-EO): "In patients on chronic RAASi for HFrEF, perioperative continuation
is reasonable.†"
Footnote *: "Patients with controlled BP and undergoing elevated-risk surgical procedures."
Footnote †: "Modified from the “2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure.”"

references.quote_excerpt: 長期的に降圧治療を受けている患者では、降圧薬は手術当日まで服用させるのが原則で、術後もできるだけ早期に再開する。

ロサルタン医療用医薬品検索結果 (KEGG MEDICUS)
2022 ESC Guidelines on cardiovascular assessment and management of patients undergoing non-cardiac surgery
references.quote_excerpt: In patients without HF, withholding RAAS inhibitors on the day of NCS should be considered to prevent peri-operative hypotension. (Class IIa, Level of Evidence B) ... discontinuation of these drugs in the 24 h before surgery was associated with a lower risk of intra-operative hypotension (adjusted RR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.72-0.93; P < 0.001), and associated with a reduction in the composite end-point consisting of all-cause mortality, stroke, and MI … If an ACEI/ARB is withheld prior to NCS, it should be restarted as soon as possible in order to prevent unintended long-term omission.
references.quote_translation_excerpt: 心不全のない患者では、非心臓手術の当日 (day of NCS) に RAAS 阻害薬 (ACE 阻害薬 / ARB) の中止を考慮すべき (術中低血圧予防、Class IIa エビデンス B)。手術 24 時間前中止で術中低血圧率が有意に低下し、全死亡・脳卒中・心筋梗塞複合エンドポイントも減少。中止した場合はできるだけ速やかに再開

references.source: ACC/AHA (米国心臓病学会 + 米国心臓協会、9 学会共同)
references.title: 2024 AHA/ACC/ACS/ASNC/HRS/SCA/SCCT/SCMR/SVM Guideline for Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery
references.quote_excerpt: Rec 1 (COR 2b, LOE B-R): In select* patients on chronic renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibitors (RAASi) for HTN undergoing elevated-risk NCS, omission 24 hours before surgery may be beneficial to limit intraoperative hypotension. (*Patients with controlled BP and undergoing elevated-risk surgical procedures.) Rec 2 (COR 2a, LOE C-EO): In patients on chronic RAASi for HFrEF, perioperative continuation is reasonable. (Modified from the "2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure.")
references.quote_translation_excerpt: Rec 1 (推奨度 IIb, エビデンス B-R): 血圧コントロール良好で高リスク非心臓手術を受ける高血圧適応の慢性 RAASi (ACE 阻害薬/ARB) 服用中の select 患者では、術前 24 時間の休薬が術中低血圧抑制に有益となりうる。Rec 2 (推奨度 IIa, エビデンス C-EO): HFrEF に対して慢性 RAASi を服用中の患者では周術期継続が妥当。
references.location_in_source: p.70 Section 'Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System Inhibitors', Recommendations Table (COR/LOE)
